challenge.method: Test whether the general KVIrc license introduction or a generic OpenSSL linking notice could identify the same instrument without the defined terms and grant.
challenge.results: Sections 0 and 1 identify both sides of the combination, include derivative works and specify how the notice conveys permission. The general GPL introduction alone lacks those features.

limitations: Active is the Index's editorial state for this identity. Inclusion of the notice with a distribution constitutes the stated grant, and the text allows a distributor to remove the section.
